matched: 1.5-year continuous operation of outdoor 470-L MPBR pilot plant
Two flat-panel PBRs (1.25 x 2 x 0.1 m)
Two-step harvesting system with 14-L tanks and 3.44 m2 hollow-fibre UF membranes (PURON KMS PUR-PSH31, 0.03 um)
Regularly calibrated on-line sensors for pH, T, DO, vertical PAR
SCADA-controlled PLC managing data acquisition and regulating HRT, SRT, Fair, influent/effluent flows
MPBR treated effluent from pilot AnMBR treating municipal wastewater from Carraixet WWTP (Valencia, Spain)
AnMBR targeted organic matter and pathogens, while MPBR facilitated nutrient removal for water reuse
Biomass from both stages treated by anaerobic co-digestion (AcoD) for biogas production
MPBR influent grab sampling frequency aligned with MPBR parameters, enabling independent evaluation
AnMBR biological performance excluded from LR framework due to limited dataset
230 samples collected over 10 experimental periods (2016-2018, 2-3 samples/week), excluding start-up and maintenance
Selection of LR inputs from 40 monitored variables via PCA, PLS, and MLR
Input variables categorised into operational, inflow, photosynthetic, ambient, light distribution, and effluent ammonium
Decoupling of NLR/PLR from HRT via stream blending for advanced control strategies
Incorporation of daily averages and maximums for PAR and T due to weather fluctuation impact
OD680 and DO as primary indicators of light utilization and photosynthetic efficiency
Z-score pre-screening (Zi = (xi - mui)/sigmai) with all values within acceptance threshold (0.01-2.95 < 3.0)
